blocks.text: On May 12, Healthcheck Diagnostic Laboratory, Inc. officially inaugurated its Advanced CT Imaging service, expanding outpatient diagnostic options for individuals and families in Cebu. Designed specifically for outpatient care, the service enables patients to undergo advanced CT examinations without the need for hospital admission, making diagnostic imaging more accessible and convenient. At the center of this service is the SOMATOM go.Top CT system, featuring 128-slice imaging capability. The technology supports high-quality imaging and efficient workflows, helping outpatient clinics and referring physicians obtain the diagnostic information they need to guide patient care.
